en.title: Judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.text: South Africa's Navi Pillay, a UN human rights chief and international law expert, has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her decades of work on human rights and justice.

en.title: Chattogram gets first cycle track
